snippet.title: Banquet For Fools 🍷 Release Date➡️March 5th
snippet.description:
Thanks for checking it out!

Release Date has been changed to March 5th! We've had a lot of great ideas from players for some quality of life additions and areas that could use tuning, and didn't have a compelling reason to not get these in prior to launch instead of after. More info here: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3172700/view/520863048256194076?l=english

The new extended demo is also live on Steam. Select a party and adventure around one of the maps!

Check out the GoG page or Steam page for more details:

🍷https://www.gog.com/en/game/banquet_for_fools
🍷https://store.steampowered.com/app/3172700/Banquet_for_Fools/

bye! ❤️
